device_flow: NO DEVICE -> attach virtual wearable (frozen scenarios only; MIXED recommended, not forced) -> scan -> FOUND -> connect -> CONNECTED; physical hardware always NOT CONNECTED / NOT IMPLEMENTED

event_semantics.context_inference_currency: PENDING / CURRENT / UNAVAILABLE / NONE_FOR_WINDOW per window timestamp; stale values never shown as current
event_semantics.contract: PRODUCT_LIVE_EVENT_V1 monitoring kinds only (federation kinds rejected)
event_semantics.quality_vs_monitoring_state: quality.status and monitoring.state are independent channels; the product never synthesises a monitoring state (no RECHECK_SENSOR from UNUSABLE/422)
event_semantics.replay: each (re)connect resets derived state and rebuilds from sequence 0 (no double counting)
event_semantics.sequence: next = previous + 1; gap/duplicate -> PRODUCT STREAM ERROR, stop, explicit reconnect
event_semantics.waveform: 360 Hz ADC_COUNTS simulated source ECG, bounded 10 s rolling buffer, null = gap (never zero/interpolated)

purpose: Turn the EXISTING SvelteKit frontend into the faculty-demonstrable capstone product interface (CAPSTONE_UI_V1) over the real CAP-004 backend: sign-in (DEMO / official ClerkJS), product shell, device lifecycle, live monitoring, persisted sessions, claim corrections and an offline DEMO path - with no backend, FL, analytics or hardware change.

legacy./monitoring: retained, labelled RESEARCH RUNTIME TOOL (research replay), logic untouched

session_flow: create (DEVICE_READY) -> open socket -> start -> MONITORING -> natural completion or stop -> COMPLETED -> persisted; refresh reloads from the backend; the live journal of a past process is never replayed

websocket_policy.reconnect: bounded: 3 retries, delays 500/1000/2000 ms, then LIVE STREAM DISCONNECTED + explicit reconnect
